statement: Lambda's public on-demand GPU cloud list price for an NVIDIA H100 SXM (80GB) is $3.99 per GPU-hour on 8x instances, with B200 SXM6 at $6.69 and A100 SXM (80GB) at $2.79 on the same configuration.
why: A published list rental rate is a static level for the rental-price overlay; the page gives no baseline or prior price, so no direction can be read from it.

impact.mechanism: Public on-demand rental list rates set the reference cost of renting versus owning accelerators, but with no stated change this is a level observation only.

confidence.basis: Vendor's own public pricing page, read directly, but a single secondary source with no publication date shown on the page.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 6.99 -> 3.99 (tol 1%); sources: Lambda (Lambda Labs)
